page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with marginal notes in the left margin. Left margin: notes beside lines 1, 2 and 3 of the top block, beside the lines around "Quos cum", beside "prum trahebatur", beside "dicorum", beside "Sodoma" and "conflagratio", and beside "liae exiftimantes". Bottom right: catchword "idem".

main_text.p: *Tum, forte.cisionis impofita cft.erat ei autem{*}ex an-cilla filius Ismael: & cum ipfe esset annorum centum, uxor autem ejus nonaginta, futurum eis filium Isaac, Dominus pollicetur, qui cum duobus angelis ad eum venerat. Inde Sodomam misi angeli, Lot in porta sedentem reperierunt. Gen.19.Quos cum ille, homines existimans, hospitio receptos, coenatosque domi haberet: juventus improba ex opido, novos hospites ad stuprum flagitabant. Lot pro hospitibus filias offerens, non acquiescentibus, quibus illicita potius desiderio erant, ipse ad stuprum trahebatur. Ibid. & Sap.19.Quem angeli propere ab injuria vindicantes, luminibus impudicorum caecitatem offuderunt. Ibid. & Sap.10.Tum Lot, ab hospitibus edoctus perdendi opidum, propere cum uxore, & filiabus est egressus: interdictum tamen eis est, ne retrorsum conspicerent. Sed mulier paru dicto audiens (humano malo, quo aegrius veritis abstinetur) reflexit oculos, statimque in molem conversa traditur. Sodoma conflagratio.At Sodomadi-vinis ignibus conflagravit. Lot autem filiae existimantes humanum genus interiisse, concubitu inebriati patris appetiverunt: unde Moab & Ammon nati sunt. Ibid. & Esa.13.Per idem

page.notes: The page-number mark "ro" is printed and kept as it appears; it is probably "70". Some ligatures and long-s forms are read as plain s, as the rules require: "Ifmael" is printed with a long s, and "effet" stands for "esset". The final word "Pet" is uncertain and may be "Per", so it is marked [?] in the text. The marginal references are partly worn. The asterisk in "autem*ex" is a reference mark for the note "Tum, forte". "Efa.13" is read as "Esa.13", and the note letters are assumed. Also "cft" is printed as it stands.
